title: Vision-Language Models Can Self-Improve Reasoning via Reflection
authors_zh: Kanzhi Cheng、Yantao Li、Fangzhi Xu、Jianbing Zhang、Hao Zhou、Yang Liu
paper_type_zh: 多模态迭代自训练与测试时选择配方
best_for_zh: 关注多模态 rollout、自训练数据构造、候选选择、结果验证与 rationale 忠实性审计的研究者
one_line: R3V repeatedly samples answer-labelled multimodal CoT, trains on a latest positive, a negative-to-positive refinement, and three-candidate answer selection, then reuses the selector for test-time compute.
R3V 反复采样按最终答案标注的多模态 CoT，以最新正例、负例条件下的正例模仿和三候选答案选择进行训练，并在测试时复用选择能力。
why: It connects iterative rollout refresh, negative-context SFT and candidate-conditioned inference in one inspectable recipe, while showing directly that gold-answer correctness can retain unfaithful multimodal rationales and that missing frozen rollout/decision ledgers limit reuse.
inclusion_reason: R3V is an auditable multimodal rollout recipe that refreshes self-generated positive and negative full solutions across iterations, turns selected failures into refinement and three-candidate comparison contexts, and reuses the learned selector for test-time compute. Its own fidelity audit makes the gap between gold-answer verification and faithful rationale supervision a first-class Atlas risk.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal chain-of-thought self-training needs more than a way to produce additional text: it needs an evidence-backed rule for deciding which generated solutions enter the next training round. In visual reasoning, a model can reach the reference answer while misreading an image, confusing symbols, or using an invalid calculation. Final-answer accuracy is therefore useful as inexpensive feedback, but it is not equivalent to step-validity or rationale faithfulness.

R3V studies whether a Vision-Language Model can bootstrap from a small GPT-4o rationale warm-up and then improve primarily from its own repeated full-solution rollouts. The concrete problem is how to retain answer-correct attempts, make selected failures useful without treating them as desired outputs, and use multiple attempts at inference without adding a separate verifier model.

This framing creates two audit questions. First, what exactly survives from the positive and negative pools into direct SFT, refinement, and selection records? Second, does the released artifact preserve enough candidate, label, decision, and checkpoint lineage to reproduce or inspect the claimed loop? The paper specifies the recipe, but the official release does not freeze the self-generated rollout corpus or its construction ledger.

多模态 chain-of-thought 自训练不只需要生成更多文本，还需要有证据支撑的规则来决定哪些生成解进入下一轮训练。在视觉推理中，模型可能在误读图像、混淆符号或计算无效的情况下碰巧得到参考答案。因此，最终答案正确性可以提供低成本反馈，却不等同于步骤有效性或 rationale 忠实性。

R3V 研究 Vision-Language Model 能否从少量 GPT-4o rationale 热身数据起步，之后主要依靠自身反复生成的完整解答 rollout 持续改进。具体问题是：如何保留答案正确的尝试，如何在不把失败答案当作目标输出的前提下利用选中的失败，以及如何在推理时利用多个尝试而不另设 verifier model。

这一设定带来两个审计问题。第一，正负样本池中究竟有哪些对象进入 direct SFT、refinement 和 selection 记录？第二，官方发布是否保留了足够的候选、标签、选择决策和 checkpoint 谱系，以复现或检查所宣称的迭代环？论文明确了配方，但官方 release 没有冻结自生成 rollout 语料及其构造账本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
R3V represents each attempt as an image-grounded question or task, a complete generated rationale and final answer, and a binary terminal outcome. For TabMWP, ChartQA and CLEVR-Math, task-specific parsers compare the final answer with the reference; MiniWob uses the simulated environment's 0/1 success reward. This outcome partitions complete solutions into local positive and negative pools. It does not label individual reasoning steps.

The same accumulated pool is converted into three SFT task families. Direct solution training uses the latest available positive full solution. Self-refine places the latest negative full solution in the user context and uses the latest positive full solution as the assistant target; this is negative-conditioned imitation of an answer-correct peer completion, not a verified edit of the supplied error. Self-select shows exactly three shuffled candidates and trains the model to emit the correct final answer.

The construction scripts can create two three-candidate patterns for an eligible item: the latest two positives with the latest negative, and the latest positive with the latest two negatives. Both require mixed labels and at least one positive. At test time, the trained MLLM receives newly sampled candidate solutions and generates the final answer itself, so the selection ability becomes a test-time-compute mechanism rather than a separate calibrated scoring head.

The central data contribution is consequently a rollout-to-SFT transformation contract: terminally labelled full solutions are accumulated, recent positives and negatives are composed into direct, refinement, and selection conversations, and the updated model produces the next candidate distribution. The released data, however, contains prepared QA and GPT-CoT warm-up rows rather than this derived corpus.

R3V 把每次尝试表示为图像条件下的问题或任务、完整生成的 rationale 与最终答案，以及一个二值终局结果。TabMWP、ChartQA 和 CLEVR-Math 使用任务特定解析器将最终答案与参考答案比较；MiniWob 使用模拟环境的 0/1 成功奖励。该结果把完整解答划分到本地正样本池和负样本池，但不会给单个推理步骤加标签。

同一个累积样本池被转换成三类 SFT 任务。Direct solution training 使用最新可用的正例完整解答。Self-refine 把最新负例完整解答放进用户上下文，以最新正例完整解答作为 assistant target；这属于负例条件下对答案正确的同伴 completion 进行模仿，而不是对给定错误进行验证过的编辑。Self-select 展示恰好三个经随机换序的候选，并训练模型输出正确的最终答案。

对于满足条件的样本，构造脚本最多可产生两种三候选模式：最新两个正例加最新一个负例，以及最新一个正例加最新两个负例。两种模式都要求候选标签有正有负且至少有一个正例。测试时，训练后的 MLLM 接收新采样的候选解答并自行生成最终答案，因此选择能力成为一种 test-time compute 机制，而不是独立的校准评分头。

因此，其核心数据贡献是一套从 rollout 到 SFT 的转换契约：累积带终局标签的完整解答，把较新的正负例组合成 direct、refinement 和 selection 对话，再由更新后的模型产生下一轮候选分布。然而，公开数据只包含准备后的 QA 与 GPT-CoT 热身记录，并不包含这套派生语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper covers TabMWP, ChartQA's human-written split, CLEVR-Math, MiniWob, the English GeoQA translation from UniGeo, and M3CoT. A source object contains an image, question, optional choices or structured context, and reference final answer; MiniWob additionally supplies HTML and asks for Python keyboard/mouse action code. Main experiments use Qwen-VL and LLaVA-1.5, while a stronger-backbone study uses Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct on GeoQA. Exact base checkpoint and tokenizer revisions are not pinned.

GPT-4o provides warm-up CoT for 1,000 TabMWP, 800 ChartQA, 1,000 CLEVR-Math, 550 MiniWob, 936 M3CoT, and 536 GeoQA items in the main experiments. Thereafter the current task-specific MLLM samples complete rationale-answer solutions. The paper defaults to three new solutions per item per sampling iteration and reports four or five task-dependent iterations until saturation. The released helper samples with top-k 50, top-p 0.95, temperature 0.9, and at most 384 new tokens; generation, shuffle, and candidate-order seeds are undisclosed.

For answer verification, TabMWP extracts and normalizes option letters or free-form values before equality comparison. ChartQA accepts numeric predictions within 5 percent of the reference and otherwise uses case-insensitive exact text. CLEVR-Math extracts an integer following Answer: and compares equality. MiniWob supplies environmental success. GeoQA and M3CoT use their benchmark evaluators. These rules create positive and negative full-solution pools from terminal outcomes; no process verifier checks whether intermediate perception, symbols, calculations, or deductions are valid.

At each rebuild, a direct SFT object takes the latest positive. If both labels are present, a refinement object embeds the latest negative in the prompt and targets the latest positive. Selection objects contain exactly three candidates: when available, the latest two positives plus latest negative and the latest positive plus latest two negatives form separate records, after random display-order shuffling. The selector's target is the correct final answer extracted from a positive completion, not a candidate ID, confidence, reward, or explanation of why alternatives fail.

Multi-task causal SFT mixes direct solution, self-refine, and self-select objects. Table 6 reports global batch size 64, learning rate 3e-5, three epochs, constant schedule with warm-up ratio 0.1, weight decay 0, and AdamW. LoRA rank/alpha is 64/16 for Qwen-VL and 128/256 for LLaVA-1.5, with dropout 0.05 and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2. The updated checkpoint generates the next pool, so the generation distribution changes across iterations.

The main controller's default five loops train loop 0 on direct QA plus GPT warm-up, then sample three files from each completed earlier checkpoint and accumulate them for reconstruction. By the last loop this can expose up to 12 generated candidates per item from four checkpoints, although realized counts and parser failures are not published. Test-time selection normally samples three complete solutions, places them with the original image/question into the MLLM context, and takes one greedy selector response; no threshold, tie rule, or abstention mechanism is disclosed.

The main repository releases 40,457 direct-QA rows across TabMWP, ChartQA, and CLEVR-Math, plus 2,800 GPT-CoT warm-up rows per base-model variant—5,600 across the Qwen-VL and LLaVA-1.5 variants. These JSON records contain image and a two-turn conversations structure. The self-generated rollouts, terminal labels, iteration identities, derived direct/refine/select decisions, D_REF and D_SEL corpora, final mixed files, checkpoints, and run logs are generated locally and are not frozen in the release.

论文覆盖 TabMWP、ChartQA 的 human-written split、CLEVR-Math、MiniWob、来自 UniGeo 的英文 GeoQA 翻译，以及 M3CoT。源对象包含图像、问题、可选选项或结构化上下文和参考最终答案；MiniWob 还提供 HTML，并要求生成表示键盘或鼠标动作的 Python code。主要实验使用 Qwen-VL 和 LLaVA-1.5，更强 backbone 实验在 GeoQA 上使用 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct。基础 checkpoint 和 tokenizer 的精确 revision 未固定。

主要实验中，GPT-4o 分别为 1,000 条 TabMWP、800 条 ChartQA、1,000 条 CLEVR-Math、550 条 MiniWob、936 条 M3CoT 和 536 条 GeoQA 样本提供 CoT 热身数据。此后，由当前任务特定 MLLM 采样完整 rationale-answer 解答。论文默认每个样本每轮新采样三个解答，并按任务运行四轮或五轮直到表现饱和。公开生成 helper 使用 top-k 50、top-p 0.95、temperature 0.9 和最多 384 个新 token；生成、shuffle 和候选顺序种子未披露。

在答案验证方面，TabMWP 提取并规范化选项字母或自由形式数值，再做相等比较。ChartQA 接受与参考值相差不超过 5% 的数值预测，否则使用不区分大小写的文本精确匹配。CLEVR-Math 提取 Answer: 之后的整数并比较相等性。MiniWob 提供环境成功信号。GeoQA 和 M3CoT 使用各自 benchmark evaluator。这些规则依据终局结果生成正负完整解答池；没有 process verifier 检查中间视觉感知、符号、计算或推导是否有效。

每次重建数据时，direct SFT 对象取最新正例。若正负标签同时存在，refinement 对象把最新负例嵌入 prompt，并以最新正例为 target。Selection 对象恰好包含三个候选：在条件允许时，最新两个正例加最新一个负例，以及最新一个正例加最新两个负例，分别构成一条记录，展示顺序会被随机打乱。Selector 的 target 是从正例 completion 中提取的正确最终答案，而不是候选 ID、置信度、reward 或对其他候选错误原因的说明。

Multi-task causal SFT 混合 direct solution、self-refine 和 self-select 对象。Table 6 报告 global batch size 64、learning rate 3e-5、3 个 epoch、带 warm-up ratio 0.1 的 constant schedule、weight decay 0 和 AdamW。Qwen-VL 的 LoRA rank/alpha 为 64/16，LLaVA-1.5 为 128/256，dropout 为 0.05，并使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-2。更新后的 checkpoint 生成下一轮样本池，因此候选生成分布会随迭代变化。

主 controller 默认五个 loop：loop 0 使用 direct QA 加 GPT 热身数据训练，之后从每个已完成的早期 checkpoint 各采样三个文件，并把它们累积起来重建数据。到最后一轮，每个样本最多可接触来自四个 checkpoint 的 12 个生成候选，但实际数量和解析失败数未发布。测试时通常采样三个完整解答，将它们连同原始图像和问题放进 MLLM 上下文，再取得一次 greedy selector response；论文未披露 threshold、tie rule 或 abstention mechanism。

主仓库公开了 TabMWP、ChartQA 和 CLEVR-Math 共 40,457 条 direct-QA 记录，以及每个基础模型变体 2,800 条 GPT-CoT 热身记录——Qwen-VL 与 LLaVA-1.5 两个变体合计 5,600 条。这些 JSON 记录只有 image 和两轮 conversations 结构。自生成 rollouts、终局标签、迭代身份、派生 direct/refine/select 决策、D_REF 与 D_SEL 语料、最终混合文件、checkpoints 和 run logs 都在本地生成，官方 release 未将其冻结。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 reports that, averaged over the six in-domain tasks, Qwen-VL reaches 64.37 with R3V versus 59.28 with STaR and 48.47 with GPT-distilled training. LLaVA-1.5 reaches 59.03 versus 55.81 and 45.24 respectively. These are author-reported downstream model outcomes; they do not by themselves establish that individual retained rationales are correct, diverse, licensed, or reusable.

The component ablation in Table 3 reports a Qwen-VL average of 64.37 for the full recipe, 62.50 without self-refine, 60.78 without self-select, and 60.64 without iterative training. This supports the joint recipe under the tested setup, but it does not isolate the causal quality of the chosen positive or negative records. In particular, the “latest” rule is an ordering heuristic, not an independent rationale-quality score.

For out-of-domain test-time selection, Table 2 reports Qwen-VL changes from 35.63 to 38.48 on MMMU, 35.10 to 35.80 on MathVista, and 50.23 to 51.78 on VCR when three-sample selection is added to R3V. Figures 4 and 5 compare selection with Test@1 and majority voting and show improvement that eventually plateaus as candidate sets grow. Exact token, FLOP, latency, hardware, and per-point candidate budgets are not tabulated, so the scaling result should be read as method evidence rather than a normalized compute-efficiency claim.

Table 4 supplies a useful negative result: for LLaVA, STaR+DPO averages 55.90, nearly unchanged from STaR at 55.81 and below R3V at 59.03. This supports the authors' observation for their noisy-CoT DPO setup, not a general claim that preference learning is ineffective.

The strongest audit evidence comes from the paper's rationale-fidelity study. The authors manually classify 100 answer-correct Qwen-VL samples per task, yet only 8% to 70% of the multimodal samples are fully correct CoT depending on the task. The paper shows perception, symbol, calculation, and reasoning errors paired with correct final answers. This directly demonstrates rationale-level false positives in the gold-answer verifier. The paper does not disclose the full rubric, annotator count, inter-annotator agreement, adjudication procedure, or sampled record IDs.

Artifact inspection verifies the official NAACL paper, DOI, arXiv record, main code/data repository, and official Qwen2-VL companion. It also verifies the 40,457 direct-QA rows and 2,800 warm-up rows per base-model variant. No immutable release or tag, frozen generated rollout pool, per-iteration positive/negative ledger, derived D_REF/D_SEL files, final mixture, checkpoint, or replay log was found. Thus citation and recipe evidence are strong, while derived-data completeness remains partial.

Table 1 报告，在六个 in-domain 任务上取平均，Qwen-VL 使用 R3V 达到 64.37，而 STaR 为 59.28，GPT-distilled training 为 48.47；LLaVA-1.5 分别为 59.03、55.81 和 45.24。这些是作者报告的下游模型结果，本身不能证明单条保留 rationale 正确、多样、具有清晰许可证或可复用。

Table 3 的组件消融报告：完整配方的 Qwen-VL 平均分为 64.37，去掉 self-refine 为 62.50，去掉 self-select 为 60.78，去掉 iterative training 为 60.64。这支持受测设置下的组合配方，但没有隔离出所选正例或负例的数据质量因果效应。尤其是，“latest” 规则只是顺序启发式，不是独立的 rationale 质量分数。

在 out-of-domain test-time selection 中，Table 2 报告给 R3V 加入三样本选择后，Qwen-VL 在 MMMU 上从 35.63 升至 38.48，在 MathVista 上从 35.10 升至 35.80，在 VCR 上从 50.23 升至 51.78。Figures 4 和 5 将 selection 与 Test@1、majority voting 比较，并显示候选集合增大后提升最终趋于平台。论文未列出精确 token、FLOP、latency、hardware 和每个数据点的候选预算，因此该 scaling 结果应视为方法证据，而不是经过归一化的计算效率结论。

Table 4 提供了有价值的负结果：LLaVA 的 STaR+DPO 平均分为 55.90，与 STaR 的 55.81 几乎不变，并低于 R3V 的 59.03。这支持作者对其 noisy-CoT DPO 设置的观察，但不能推广成“偏好学习无效”的一般结论。

最关键的审计证据来自论文的 rationale-fidelity 研究。作者对每个任务随机抽取 100 条答案正确的 Qwen-VL 样本进行人工分类，但依任务不同，多模态样本中只有 8% 到 70% 被判断为 fully correct CoT。论文展示了最终答案正确却伴随视觉感知、符号、计算和推理错误的案例。这直接证明 gold-answer verifier 会在 rationale 层面产生 false positive。论文未公开完整 rubric、annotator 数量、inter-annotator agreement、adjudication 流程和样本记录 ID。

Artifact 检查验证了官方 NAACL 论文、DOI、arXiv 记录、主代码/数据仓库，以及官方 Qwen2-VL companion，也验证了 40,457 条 direct-QA 记录和每个基础模型变体 2,800 条热身记录。检查中未发现 immutable release 或 tag、冻结的生成 rollout 池、逐轮正负样本账本、派生 D_REF/D_SEL 文件、最终 mixture、checkpoint 或 replay log。因此，引用与配方证据较强，但派生数据完整性仍是 partial。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
R3V combines three roles for the same self-generated full-solution pool: accepted completions become direct SFT targets, selected failures become context for negative-conditioned refinement, and mixed three-candidate sets train answer selection. The selector is then reused at inference, connecting training-time rollout construction with test-time compute in one MLLM rather than requiring an external reward model or verifier head.

Relative to answer-only self-training such as STaR, the distinct contribution is not simply repeated sampling. It is the conversion of both terminally positive and negative completions into three supervised interaction formats, followed by iterative regeneration from updated checkpoints. Relative to preference learning, negatives are not optimized as rejected outputs with DPO in the proposed R3V objective; they are placed in the input context for refinement and comparison.

The method is best described as outcome-labelled rollout composition, not process supervision. Its feedback is denser at the conversation-format level because a failure can be shown to the model, but the only correctness ground truth remains the parsed final answer or environment success. The paper's own fidelity audit is important precisely because it prevents the observed benchmark gains from being mistaken for proof that the retained reasoning traces are faithful.

R3V 让同一个自生成完整解答池承担三种角色：通过验证的 completion 成为 direct SFT target，选中的失败成为负例条件 refinement 的上下文，正负混合的三候选集合用于训练答案选择。Selector 随后在推理阶段被复用，使训练时 rollout 构造与 test-time compute 在同一个 MLLM 中连接起来，而不需要外部 reward model 或 verifier head。

相对 STaR 等只按答案自训练的方法，其差异不只是反复采样，而是把终局正例和负例都转换成三种监督交互格式，再从更新后的 checkpoint 迭代生成新候选。相对偏好学习，R3V 提出的目标并不通过 DPO 把负例作为 rejected output 优化；负例出现在输入上下文中，用于 refinement 与 comparison。

该方法更准确的描述是“带结果标签的 rollout 组合”，而非 process supervision。失败样本可以展示给模型，因此在对话格式层面反馈更丰富，但唯一的正确性真值仍是解析后的最终答案或环境成功信号。论文自己的 fidelity audit 之所以重要，正是因为它阻止读者把 benchmark 增益误解为“保留的推理轨迹已经忠实”的证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The terminal verifier cannot establish rationale faithfulness. An answer-correct completion may contain visual, symbolic, arithmetic, or logical errors, and Figure 6 shows that this is observed rather than hypothetical. Conversely, equivalent answers outside a parser's accepted form, ChartQA tolerance boundaries, malformed formatting, or incomplete environment execution can create false negatives. Self-refine targets are merely answer-correct peer completions, so they can replace one flawed path with a different lucky-answer path.

The three-candidate selector is trained on constructed sets guaranteed to contain at least one positive and mixed labels. At inference, all candidates may be wrong. The selector emits an answer rather than a calibrated correctness score and has no disclosed threshold, abstention rule, uncertainty estimate, or independent reference access. It may exploit answer frequency, formatting, or generator-specific style; no adversarial-candidate, cross-generator, calibration, or all-wrong-set audit is reported.

“Latest positive” and “latest negative” refer to iteration or list order, not independently measured rationale quality. Candidate display order is shuffled without released seeds. Exact positive, negative, malformed, duplicate, timeout, parser-failure, and derived-record counts are absent by task, model, and iteration, so selection yield and failure retention cannot be reconstructed. Other raw candidates may remain in local run files but do not survive as a published rejection ledger.

The official release is incomplete for data reuse. It publishes 40,457 direct-QA rows and 2,800 GPT-CoT warm-up rows per Qwen-VL or LLaVA-1.5 variant for three tasks, but not the frozen self-generated rollouts, terminal labels, iteration/sample IDs, selected-candidate IDs, D_REF, D_SEL, final mixed training files, model checkpoints, or run logs. Main code/data covers TabMWP, ChartQA, and CLEVR-Math; Qwen2-VL/GeoQA is separate, and equivalent complete artifacts for MiniWob and M3CoT are unavailable.

Reproducibility details remain unknown: exact base-model and tokenizer revisions, generation/data/order seeds, the precise four-versus-five-iteration stopping rule, immutable prompt/config bundles, task-level hardware/runtime budgets, and checkpoint hashes. The main and companion repositories have no immutable GitHub release or tag. The manual fidelity study also lacks its rubric, annotator count, agreement, adjudication, and sampled IDs.

Named dataset splits are reported, but immutable row manifests, exact/near/semantic-overlap checks, and pretraining-contamination analysis are not. The paper is CC BY 4.0 and the repositories declare Apache-2.0, yet no row-level license and attribution matrix covers the upstream datasets and images, GPT-4o annotations, or generated traces. Repository code licensing must not be treated as clearance to redistribute every training record. Evidence is confined to the named multimodal benchmarks and one simulated web environment, not safety-critical or adversarial open-ended reasoning.

终局 verifier 不能证明 rationale 忠实性。答案正确的 completion 仍可能含有视觉、符号、算术或逻辑错误，Figure 6 表明这不是假设，而是实际观察。反过来，超出解析器接受形式的等价答案、ChartQA 容差边界、格式异常或环境执行不完整也可能造成 false negative。Self-refine target 只是答案正确的同伴 completion，因此可能用另一条碰巧答对但同样有缺陷的路径替换原有错误路径。

三候选 selector 的训练集合由构造保证至少含一个正例且标签有正有负，而推理时所有候选都可能错误。Selector 输出答案而不是校准后的正确性分数，也没有公开 threshold、abstention rule、uncertainty estimate 或独立参考答案访问。它可能利用答案频率、格式或生成器特定风格；论文未报告 adversarial-candidate、cross-generator、calibration 或 all-wrong-set 审计。

“Latest positive”和“latest negative”指迭代或列表顺序，而不是独立测得的 rationale 质量。候选展示顺序会随机打乱，但种子未公开。按任务、模型和迭代划分的正例、负例、异常、重复、超时、解析失败和派生记录数量均缺失，因此无法重建筛选产率与失败保留情况。其他原始候选可能存在于本地运行文件中，却没有作为公开 rejection ledger 保留下来。

官方 release 对数据复用并不完整。它为三个任务公开了 40,457 条 direct-QA 记录，以及每个 Qwen-VL 或 LLaVA-1.5 变体 2,800 条 GPT-CoT 热身记录，但没有冻结自生成 rollouts、终局标签、迭代/样本 ID、入选候选 ID、D_REF、D_SEL、最终混合训练文件、model checkpoints 或 run logs。主代码/数据只覆盖 TabMWP、ChartQA 和 CLEVR-Math；Qwen2-VL/GeoQA 位于独立仓库，MiniWob 和 M3CoT 没有同等完整的 artifact。

可复现性信息仍为 unknown：基础模型和 tokenizer 的精确 revision、生成/数据/顺序种子、四轮还是五轮的精确停止规则、immutable prompt/config bundle、任务级 hardware/runtime budget 和 checkpoint hash。主仓库与 companion repository 都没有不可变的 GitHub release 或 tag。人工 fidelity 研究也没有公开 rubric、annotator 数量、agreement、adjudication 和样本 ID。

论文报告了具名 dataset split，但没有 immutable row manifest、exact/near/semantic-overlap 检查和 pretraining-contamination 分析。论文为 CC BY 4.0，代码仓库声明 Apache-2.0，但没有覆盖上游数据集与图像、GPT-4o annotation 和生成 trace 的行级 license/attribution matrix。不能把仓库代码许可证视为重新分发所有训练记录的许可。证据范围仅限具名多模态 benchmark 和一个模拟 web environment，并未覆盖安全关键或对抗性的开放式推理。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track, R3V is a concrete example of repeated independent full-solution sampling whose value comes from how the traces are labelled, retained, recomposed, and refreshed. It is not tree search: the search substrate is stochastic candidate generation, answer-level partitioning, and candidate-conditioned selection. Track comparisons should therefore record both the three-new-rollouts-per-iteration budget and the accumulated multi-checkpoint pool exposed by the released controller.

As a post-training recipe, it shows how to use negative trajectories without optimizing them as desired outputs: selected negatives become input context for refinement and comparison, while latest positives supply assistant targets. A careful reimplementation should retain every raw candidate with source ID, model/checkpoint revision, iteration, sample index, parsed answer, terminal label, parser version, and selection decision. It should freeze direct, D_REF, and D_SEL outputs rather than publish only source QA and warm-up conversations.

As a test-time-compute baseline, the method is useful for comparing learned selection with Test@1, majority voting, best-of-N, or external-verifier selection. Fair comparison requires candidate count, total tokens, latency, hardware, selector-call cost, and all-wrong-set behavior. Because the selector emits an answer rather than a score, downstream systems should not treat it as a calibrated verifier unless calibration and abstention are added and evaluated.

For verifier and data-quality research, the paper offers a clear failure case for gold-answer filtering: correct outcomes can preserve invalid multimodal CoT. Reusers should add independent step or perception checks, release the manual fidelity ledger, audit parser boundaries, and test cross-generator/adversarial candidates. Benchmark improvements can justify studying the recipe, but they are not evidence that the derived traces are faithful.

For release engineering, the missing artifacts define a practical audit checklist: frozen rollouts, positive/negative and malformed-case counts, decision ledgers, exact model and tokenizer revisions, seeds, prompts, evaluator versions, checkpoints, logs, split/decontamination manifests, and row-level license lineage. Until these exist, R3V is best reused as an inspectable construction pattern, not assumed to be a ready-made open rollout dataset.

对于 Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data track，R3V 是一个具体案例：反复独立采样完整解答，其价值取决于 trace 如何被标注、保留、重新组合和刷新。它不是 tree search；其 search substrate 是随机候选生成、答案级划分和候选条件选择。因此，进行 track 内比较时，既应记录每轮三个新 rollout 的预算，也应记录公开 controller 实际使用的跨 checkpoint 累积样本池。

作为 post-training 配方，它展示了如何在不把负轨迹优化为期望输出的情况下利用负例：选中的负例成为 refinement 和 comparison 的输入上下文，最新正例提供 assistant target。严谨复现应保留每个原始候选的 source ID、model/checkpoint revision、iteration、sample index、parsed answer、terminal label、parser version 和 selection decision，并冻结 direct、D_REF 与 D_SEL 输出，而不只是发布源 QA 与热身对话。

作为 test-time-compute baseline，该方法适合与 Test@1、majority voting、best-of-N 或 external-verifier selection 比较。公平比较需要报告候选数、总 token、latency、hardware、selector call 成本和 all-wrong-set 行为。由于 selector 输出答案而不是分数，下游系统不应把它当成校准 verifier，除非另行加入并评估 calibration 与 abstention。

对于 verifier 与数据质量研究，论文提供了 gold-answer filtering 的明确失败案例：正确结果可能保留无效的多模态 CoT。复用者应增加独立的步骤或视觉感知检查，发布人工 fidelity ledger，审计 parser 边界，并测试 cross-generator/adversarial candidates。Benchmark 提升可以证明该配方值得研究，却不能证明派生 trace 是忠实的。

对于 release engineering，缺失 artifact 本身形成了一份实用审计清单：冻结 rollouts、正负与异常样本数量、decision ledger、精确 model 和 tokenizer revision、seeds、prompts、evaluator versions、checkpoints、logs、split/decontamination manifest，以及行级 license lineage。在这些材料公开前，R3V 更适合作为可检查的构造模式复用，而不应被视作现成的开放 rollout dataset。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the feedback boundary explicit: final parsed answer or MiniWob success labels a complete solution; no step-level verifier is present.
  • Read self-refine as latest-negative-conditioned imitation of the latest answer-correct peer completion, not as verified error repair.
  • The self-select training object always has exactly three shuffled candidates, mixed labels, and at least one positive; inference has no positive-candidate guarantee.
  • Separate the published 40,457 direct-QA rows and 2,800 GPT-CoT warm-up rows per base-model variant from the unreleased self-generated rollouts, D_REF, D_SEL, checkpoints, and ledgers.
  • Treat downstream and ablation gains as evidence for the tested recipe, while using the reported 8%–70% fully correct CoT range as direct evidence that answer correctness does not certify rationale faithfulness.

• 明确反馈边界：完整解答只由解析后的最终答案或 MiniWob 成功信号标注，没有步骤级 verifier。
  • 把 self-refine 理解为在最新负例条件下模仿最新答案正确的同伴 completion，而不是经过验证的错误修复。
  • Self-select 训练对象始终包含恰好三个随机换序候选、正负混合标签且至少一个正例；推理时没有正候选保证。
  • 区分公开的 40,457 条 direct-QA 与每个基础模型变体 2,800 条 GPT-CoT 热身记录，以及未公开的自生成 rollouts、D_REF、D_SEL、checkpoints 和账本。
  • 把下游结果和消融增益视作受测配方的证据，同时把论文报告的 8%–70% fully correct CoT 范围视作“答案正确不能认证 rationale 忠实性”的直接证据。
